The Router's visual observation of 'indistinct blobs' for the infant is more reliable than the auditor's binary mask success. The 'structural_collapse' of the hand (Severity 1.5) is also valid; the digits lack clear separation. I agree with the Router's severity ratings. The Perceptual Quality Auditor found no global distortions, which is consistent with the local nature of these anatomical artifacts.
